species.real: Male sand lizards turn bright green down their flanks in spring to impress females. In Britain they cling on to a few southern heaths and the Merseyside dunes, and have been reintroduced to dunes in Wales.
species.name: Duneskink

dex.text: Warm sand, quick feet and absolutely no interest in being picked up. Vanishes into the dunes with a flick of the tail.
dex.fact: Female sand lizards dig a small hole in warm sand to lay their eggs, then leave the eggs to hatch by themselves.
